props.name: variant
props.description: The action's weight: `primary` for the one action a screen is for, `secondary` beside it, `destructive` for what can't be undone

props.name: size
props.description: `default` is a thumb's height (44 CSS pixels); `small` only where a pointer aims

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether it is open at first (uncontrolled)

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: It opens or closes: Escape, a tap outside, or a part asking

props.name: role
props.description: `alertdialog` asks before something that cannot be undone: a tap outside does not close it, only Escape or an answer does

props.name: size
props.description: How much of the stage it takes

props.name: children
props.description: Its parts: a `Title` (it names the dialog), `Content`, `Actions`, a `Legend`

props.name: slot
props.description: What it is, for `Controls` to place it: `leave` (Back, Pause) goes to the start, `system` (the sound, fullscreen) to the end

props.name: aria-label
props.description: What the button does, for assistive technology (and a hint of its key)

props.name: label
props.description: Text beside the icon on the tall stage's bar; in a corner the icon stands alone and the `aria-label` names it

props.name: value
props.description: Cells lit; whole cells only, clamped to `0..max`

props.name: size
props.description: The cells' size: `compact` fits a long pool where room is short

props.name: blink
props.description: Blink the lit cells, between their colour and its light, at the arcade rhythm: a full pool asking to be used. Steady under reduced motion
